Title: Post composer displays required controls
Preconditions: Logged in as demo Admin-role user; on Buzz Newsfeed page (/web/index.php/buzz/viewBuzz)
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the Buzz Newsfeed page. 2. Observe the post composer region at the top of the feed.
Expected Result: Composer displays a 'What's on your mind?' textbox, a 'Post' button, a 'Share Photos' button, and a 'Share Video' button.
Comments: Structural presence only confirmed; typing/publishing behavior not exercised (see BUZZ-TC-021).

Title: Feed post card displays author, timestamp, content, and counters
Preconditions: Logged in as demo Admin-role user; feed contains existing demo posts.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the Buzz Newsfeed page. 2. Inspect each post card in the feed.
Test Data: Existing demo feed (4 posts observed: manda akhil user, Sania Shaheen, Rebecca Harmony, Russel Hamilton).
Expected Result: Each post card displays author name, avatar, timestamp, text content and/or image, and Like/Comment/Share counters (e.g. '0 Likes', '1 Like', '0 Comments', '0 Shares').
Comments: Feed data is snapshot-specific per Exploration §5 item 9; author names/counts may differ on later runs against the shared demo instance.

Title: Default feed filter is 'Most Recent Posts'
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page; feed has not been re-sorted this session.
Test Steps: 1. Load the Buzz Newsfeed page. 2. Observe which filter button carries the active state and the resulting post order.
Expected Result: 'Most Recent Posts' is the default active filter; posts appear in reverse-chronological order by timestamp.

Title: 'Most Liked Posts' filter sorts descending by Like count
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page, default 'Most Recent Posts' view active.
Test Steps: 1. Click the 'Most Liked Posts' filter button. 2. Observe the resulting post order and the button's active state.
Expected Result: Feed re-sorts posts in descending order by Like count; the 'Most Liked Posts' button gains the active state.

Title: 'Most Recent Posts' restores original feed order
Preconditions: 'Most Liked Posts' or 'Most Commented Posts' filter currently active.
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Most Recent Posts' after a different filter has been applied. 2. Compare the resulting order to the original default order.
Expected Result: Feed order is restored exactly to the original reverse-chronological order; no underlying post data is altered by re-sorting.
Comments: Confirms filter switching is fully reversible/non-destructive.

Title: Upcoming Anniversaries panel displays and is non-interactive
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page.
Test Steps: 1. Observe the 'Upcoming Anniversaries' panel on the right side of the page. 2. Click the anniversary entry.
Expected Result: Panel displays employee avatar, name, job title, a year-count badge, and a date; clicking the entry produces no navigation or visible effect (static/display-only).

Title: 'Read More' expands truncated post text
Preconditions: A post with truncated (long) text is present in the feed (e.g. Sania Shaheen's post).
Test Steps: 1. Locate a post showing a 'Read More' link below truncated text. 2. Click 'Read More'.
Expected Result: The post's full text becomes visible and the 'Read More' link disappears; no collapse/'Show Less' control appears afterward (expansion is one-directional).
Comments: Confirms PRD's mention of the control and adds the one-directional detail PRD did not state.

Title: Like/Unlike toggle updates count and icon state
Preconditions: A post with a known Like count (e.g. 0 Likes) is present.
Test Steps: 1. Click the heart icon on a post showing '0 Likes'. 2. Observe the count and icon state. 3. Click the same heart icon again. 4. Observe the count and icon state.
Expected Result: After step 1: count becomes '1 Like', heart icon turns solid red (liked state). After step 3: count returns to '0 Likes', icon returns to grey/outline (unliked state).
Comments: Like icon has no accessible name and uses a duplicated id="heart-svg" across posts - an automation-readiness concern, not a functional defect (see Locator Reference Table).

Title: Comment toggle expands/collapses inline comment box
Preconditions: A post showing '0 Comments' is present.
Test Steps: 1. Click the '0 Comments' text/icon on a post. 2. Observe the comment area. 3. Click '0 Comments' again.
Expected Result: Step 1 expands an inline 'Write your comment...' textbox beneath the post's action row, with no page navigation. Step 3 collapses the textbox again with no visible side effects.
Comments: No text was typed/submitted; see BUZZ-TC-025 for the comment-submission hypothesis case.

Title: Options menu on own post shows Edit Post and Delete Post
Preconditions: Logged in as the demo Admin-role account; the feed contains a post authored by the logged-in user (matched by avatar/display name).
Test Steps: 1. Locate the logged-in user's own post in the feed. 2. Click the '...' options icon on that post. 3. Observe the menu items shown.
Expected Result: Menu shows exactly two items: 'Edit Post' and 'Delete Post'.
Comments: This is the first direct evidence resolving BR-005 (previously entirely Unknown / Not observed in the PRD). Neither menu item was clicked.

Title: Options menu on another author's post shows Delete Post only
Preconditions: Logged in as the demo Admin-role account; the feed contains at least one post authored by a different user (e.g. Sania Shaheen, Rebecca Harmony).
Test Steps: 1. Locate a post authored by a different user. 2. Click the '...' options icon on that post. 3. Observe the menu items shown.
Expected Result: Menu shows exactly one item: 'Delete Post' (no 'Edit Post' option).
Comments: Permission/role case - confirms the Admin-role account can delete any post but only edit its own, at the UI level. Whether this is also enforced server-side is Unknown / Not exercised - see BUZZ-TC-027.

Title: Share Photos 'Share' button disabled until photo attached
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page.
Test Steps: 1. Click the 'Share Photos' button in the composer. 2. Without attaching a photo, observe the 'Share' button's state.
Expected Result: 'Share' button is disabled while no photo is attached.
Comments: Contrast with BUZZ-TC-019 (Share Video does not disable Share under the equivalent empty-input condition).

Title: Clicking attached photo opens full-screen lightbox
Preconditions: A post with an attached photo is present in the feed (e.g. Rebecca Harmony's post).
Test Steps: 1. Click the attached photo on a post. 2. Observe the resulting view. 3. Close via the 'x' button.
Expected Result: A full-screen lightbox opens showing the image enlarged alongside an independent post-detail panel (author, timestamp, caption, its own Like/Comment/Share row). Closing returns cleanly to the feed with no residual state change.
Comments: Not documented in PRD Section 6; new finding from exploration.

Title: Share Post (repost) modal opens with optional caption
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page; at least one post exists in the feed.
Test Steps: 1. Click the Share (repost) icon on a post's action row. 2. Observe the resulting dialog and the 'Share' button's state without entering a caption.
Expected Result: A 'Share Post' dialog opens with a read-only preview of the original post and an optional caption textbox; the 'Share' button is enabled even with no caption entered.
Comments: Caption appears intentionally optional (unlike Share Video's URL field); not flagged as a validation discrepancy in Exploration §5, unlike BUZZ-TC-019.

Title: Post author name/avatar click produces no navigation
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page.
Test Steps: 1. Click a post author's displayed name. 2. Observe the URL/page. 3. Click the same author's avatar image. 4. Observe the URL/page.
Expected Result: Neither click navigates away or produces a visible effect; the URL remains /web/index.php/buzz/viewBuzz throughout (no profile drill-through from the Buzz feed).

Title: Topbar 'Help' button opens external site in new tab
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page.
Test Steps: 1. Click the single icon in the Buzz Topbar Menu region (labeled with title='Help'). 2. Observe the resulting browser behavior.
Expected Result: A new browser tab opens to the external URL https://starterhelp.orangehrm.com/hc/en-us; the icon is not a collapse/hamburger navigation control.
Comments: Corrects PRD Section 5, which described this icon as a 'collapse/hamburger control'.

Title: Profile menu shows About/Support/Change Password/Logout on Buzz page
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page.
Test Steps: 1. Click the logged-in user's profile name in the top banner. 2. Observe the menu items.
Expected Result: Menu shows 'About', 'Support', 'Change Password', and 'Logout' items.
Comments: Global control re-verified specifically on the Buzz page per exploration scope; no item was selected.

Title: Feed displays all posts with no pagination at current volume
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page with the current demo data volume (4 posts observed).
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the Buzz Newsfeed page. 2. Scroll to the bottom of the feed. 3. Observe whether the page footer appears immediately after the last post.
Expected Result: All posts are shown without pagination controls or infinite-scroll loading; the page footer appears immediately after the last (4th) post.
Comments: Only verified at the current data volume (4 posts); behavior at higher post counts is Unknown / Not exercised (Exploration §7 Open Question 5).

Title: Share Video 'Share' button not disabled despite empty Video URL (defect candidate)
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page.
Test Steps: 1. Click the 'Share Video' button in the composer. 2. Leave the 'Paste Video URL' field empty. 3. Observe the 'Share' button's state.
Expected Result: DEFECT CANDIDATE: 'Share' button remains enabled/clickable despite the Video URL field being empty, unlike the equivalent Share Photos flow (BUZZ-TC-012), where Share is disabled with no photo attached. Flag for QC review as a validation asymmetry.
Comments: The button was not clicked, so whether submission actually succeeds/fails with an empty URL is unconfirmed - see BUZZ-TC-024.

Title: 'Most Liked' vs 'Most Commented' tie-break order differs
Preconditions: All posts in the feed currently have 0 Comments (as observed); Like counts vary.
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Most Liked Posts' and record the resulting order among posts tied on other attributes. 2. Click 'Most Commented Posts' and record the resulting order among the (all-zero-comment) posts. 3. Compare the two tie-break orders.
Test Data: 4-post demo feed: manda akhil user (0 Likes), Sania Shaheen (1 Like), Rebecca Harmony (0 Likes), Russel Hamilton (2 Likes) - all with 0 Comments.
Expected Result: The two filters order same-count posts differently from each other (e.g. 'Most Liked Posts' places Sania before Rebecca; 'Most Commented Posts' places Rebecca before Sania), indicating independent secondary sort keys rather than a shared stable sort.
Comments: Minor finding; underlying secondary sort key for either filter could not be determined from black-box observation (Exploration §7 Open Question 4). Test data is snapshot-specific per Exploration §5 item 9.

Title: Publish a new text post via composer
Preconditions: A disposable/sandboxed instance authorized for content-creating actions (NOT the shared public demo).
Test Steps: 1. Type text into the 'What's on your mind?' textbox. 2. Click 'Post'. 3. Observe whether the post appears in the feed and the composer's resulting state.
Test Data: Proposed sample text, e.g. 'Buzz test post - sandbox only'; also test with empty and whitespace-only input per Exploration §7 Open Question 3.
Expected Result: Requires live confirmation - not exercised this run. Whether the Post button is enabled/disabled based on input, and what appears in the feed after posting, is Unknown / Not exercised.
Comments: Excluded both by the ui-exploration skill's no-content-creation policy and by a Claude Code tool permission classifier block ("External System Writes") encountered independently this run. Must not be executed against the shared public demo instance.

Title: Upload a photo via Share Photos and publish
Preconditions: A disposable/sandboxed instance authorized for file-upload actions.
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Share Photos'. 2. Use 'Add Photos'/'Choose File' to attach an image. 3. Observe the 'Share' button state. 4. Click 'Share'.
Test Data: A sample image file (format/size limits not evidenced for Buzz uploads - Unknown / Not observed).
Expected Result: Requires live confirmation - not exercised this run. Whether the upload succeeds, what the resulting post looks like, and whether any format/size validation applies is Unknown / Not exercised.
Comments: File upload excluded by policy on the shared public demo instance.

Title: Submit Share Video with a valid URL
Preconditions: A disposable/sandboxed instance authorized for content-creating actions.
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Share Video'. 2. Enter a video URL into 'Paste Video URL'. 3. Click 'Share'. 4. Observe the resulting post.
Test Data: A sample video URL (format requirements not evidenced - Unknown / Not observed).
Expected Result: Requires live confirmation - not exercised this run.
Comments: Creates new content visible to other users of the shared demo; excluded by policy.

Title: Submit Share Video with an empty URL (defect verification)
Preconditions: A disposable/sandboxed instance authorized for content-creating actions.
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Share Video'. 2. Leave 'Paste Video URL' empty (confirmed enabled per BUZZ-TC-019). 3. Click 'Share'. 4. Observe whether a post is created and, if so, its content/appearance.
Expected Result: Requires live confirmation - not exercised this run. This directly resolves whether the enabled-but-unvalidated Share button (BUZZ-TC-019) results in a broken/empty post, a silent no-op, or a client/server-side error.
Comments: Highest-value follow-up to the BUZZ-TC-019 defect candidate; requires either a disposable instance or API-level testing outside the UI, per Exploration §6.

Title: Submit a comment on a post
Preconditions: A disposable/sandboxed instance authorized for content-creating actions.
Test Steps: 1. Click a post's comment toggle to expand the comment box. 2. Type text into 'Write your comment...'. 3. Submit the comment. 4. Observe whether it appears under the post and whether the Comment count updates.
Test Data: Proposed sample text, e.g. 'Test comment - sandbox only'.
Expected Result: Requires live confirmation - not exercised this run.
Comments: Creates new content visible to other users of the shared demo; excluded by policy.

Title: Submit a repost via Share Post modal
Preconditions: A disposable/sandboxed instance authorized for content-creating actions.
Test Steps: 1. Click the Share (repost) icon on a post. 2. Optionally enter a caption. 3. Click 'Share'. 4. Observe whether a new repost appears in the feed.
Test Data: N/A or proposed sample caption text.
Expected Result: Requires live confirmation - not exercised this run.
Comments: Creates a new post visible to other users of the shared demo; excluded by policy.

Title: Verify server-side enforcement of Edit Post permission
Preconditions: A disposable/sandboxed instance, or API-level access, authorized for edit actions on another user's record.
Test Steps: 1. As the logged-in Admin-role account, attempt to edit a post authored by a different user (e.g. via a direct API/form call, since the UI does not expose 'Edit Post' for other users' posts per BUZZ-TC-011). 2. Observe whether the server accepts or rejects the edit.
Test Data: N/A - requires a sanctioned edit-flow test or code/API review.
Expected Result: Requires live confirmation - not exercised this run. Whether 'Edit Post' visibility is a client-side-only UI check or a server-enforced permission is Unknown / Not exercised (Exploration §7 Open Question 1).
Source: Exploration - Excluded Action (§6, row 6); Exploration §7 Open Question 1
Comments: Directly follows from BUZZ-TC-010/BUZZ-TC-011's confirmed UI-level pattern; this case probes whether that pattern is also enforced server-side - an authorization/security-relevant gap, not yet a confirmed vulnerability.
